name: Asahi
message: 「Good morning, Iori-sensei」

name: Iori
message: 「Morning, Asahi」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, what will you be teaching me today?」

name: Iori
message: 「Sorry, but you'll have to practice on your own today」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ehh~, even today？」
It couldn't be helped; there weren't any students other than Asahi.

name: Asahi
message: 「You're so mean, Iori-sensei」

name: Asahi
message: 「When will you finally give me some intense, hands-on, limbs-intertwined instruction？」

name: Iori
message: 「There's no way I'm giving you that kind of sexual-harassment-style instruction」

name: Asahi
message: 「But that's what I live for!」

name: Iori
message: 「Right, here's today's training menu」
I hand her the list of exercises I put together this morning.

name: Asahi
message: 「I don't need something like this!」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, what are you doing！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I've been doing basic training since before you even got here, Iori-sensei」

name: Asahi
message: 「I want to look at your face and hear your voice while I receive instruction that only you can provide, Iori-sensei」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, and while we're at it, I also want us to touch each other」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, let's try resisting that urge」

name: Asahi
message: 「What do I have to do to get you to give me personal instruction, Iori-sensei？」
Asahi's dissatisfaction was justified. I hadn't properly instructed everyone even once yet.

name: Iori
message: 「As far as I'm concerned, I want to set up a system where I can instruct everyone equally」

name: Iori
message: 「To do that, I believe I need to gather the whole class in the classroom」
If I couldn't even manage that much, then proper instruction was just a pipe dream.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Understood」

name: Asahi
message: 「Though, personally, I'm not happy about having my time with Iori-sensei stolen by the other students」

name: Asahi
message: 「However, at this rate, I won't be able to receive your guidance either, Iori-sensei, and you'll end up losing your current position.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Therefore, deeply regrettable though it may be」

name: Asahi
message: 「I would like to lend what little help I can so that the other students will feel inclined to come to class and receive your instruction, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh, you'll help me out？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, though I do have one favor to ask in return」

name: Iori
message: 「W-What would that be？」
I hope it's something within my power to grant...

name: Asahi
message: 「Whenever you have some free time, please make time for just the two of us to be alone together, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh? Are you saying you want to go on a <d0097>date</d>?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Of course, I wouldn't mind a date at all.」
U-Uhh... Well, if it's in the form of after-school tutoring or something like that, I suppose I could manage to make some one-on-one time.

name: Iori
message: 「Got it, I promise.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Really？ Hehe, I'm so happy!」
Asahi's face lights up in an instant.

name: Asahi
message: 「Then, starting right this moment, I shall support your mission with everything I have, Iori-sensei!」
No sooner had she said that than Asahi pulled up several HR displays in front of herself.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, how dependable. What are you going to do？」

name: Asahi
message: 「To start, I'll hack into the academy's central management system.」

name: Iori
message: 「Uh-huh, uh-huh.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Accessing with a spoofed teacher account—success」

name: Asahi
message: 「Next, I'll gather information on Kazamine Setsugekka, Suzakuin Momiji, Tobe Ririmu, and Kazamine Keisetsu.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Data collection complete. Now then, who should we win over first？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, let's hold on a second.」
What she said was so hard to believe that my ears flat-out rejected it, but there's no way I can just let that slide.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Asahi, what did you just do？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I used a spoofed account to gather information on everyone in Takamura Class—was there a problem？」

name: Iori
message: 「At this point, there's nothing but problems here, right？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Indeed, if I felt so inclined, I could even secretly record shower scenes.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Though even I would feel hesitant about going that far.」

name: Iori
message: 「You can even do that？！」
Actually, when on earth did Asahi even pick up skills like that?

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, stop the hacking immediately.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Still, I don't think we can get everyone in Takamura Class to budge unless we go at least this far.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, if I just meet with them and talk things through properly...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, the Martial Festival is coming up this summer.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If we take a leisurely approach, one or two months will fly by in the blink of an eye.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ugh, th-that may be true, but...！」
Just as Asahi says, the Martial Festival is in the summer and it's already May—we don't have much time left. Everything hinges on how much intensive guidance I can pack into this short period.

name: Asahi
message: 「Don't worry, nobody is going to complain.」

name: Iori
message: 「If we get caught, it'll definitely be a huge problem！」

name: Asahi
message: 「If any teacher complains, I'll just dig up their dirt and blackmail them.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's how I transferred into Takamura Class, too, so I have a proven track record♪」

name: Iori
message: 「That's less of a track record and more of a criminal record, isn't it？！」
I get it now. It just hit me hard.
So this is what Sasaki-sensei meant by 'Asahi belongs in Takamura Class'...！

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, this is war.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Between teacher and students, who will force their own will through? It's a blood-drenched school war.」

name: Iori
message: 「I-Is it really that dramatic...？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Our opponents are little children whose mental age never grew past puberty.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You can't expect them to have the social maturity to listen to reason.」

name: Iori
message: 「You really say some brutal things so casually, don't you, Asahi...？」

name: Asahi
message: 「They will use any means necessary to get their selfish way. Do you really intend to march into that quagmire of a battle completely unarmed, Sensei？」

name: Asahi
message: 「You must master even wild powers like mine, and snatch victory for yourself.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Only with that level of resolve can one truly be called a teacher with leadership.」

name: Iori
message: 「T-that's true... I'm starting to think so too！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, I'll take on the dirty work.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please make the most of my skills and position, and exert your brilliant leadership to the fullest！」

name: Iori
message: 「Got it！ Alright, let's do this！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, let's do our best.」
We hide in the surrounding bushes, watching over the students passing through the school gate.
We decided to set Setsugekka as our target for the time being and attempt to make contact.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey Asahi, is Setsugekka really going to pass through here？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san has filed for an absence, citing poor health.」

name: Asahi
message: 「However, she left her dorm room about five minutes ago. She likely plans to cut class and go hang out.」

name: Iori
message: 「How on earth do you know that...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Using Awashima, the advanced information-gathering AI, predicting Setsugekka-san's movements is a piece of cake.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, it's a good era we live in, isn't it?」

name: Iori
message: 「Does that mean you can monitor me too？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Of course. Shall we try it?」

name: Iori
message: 「No thank you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Based on her past behavioral patterns, the prediction results show that when Setsugekka-san cuts class, she naively heads out through the school gate.」
To think my behavioral patterns are being read too... The information society is seriously scary.

name: Asahi
message: 「She should be appearing any minute now...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, here she comes.」
Just as the AI predicted, Setsugekka came along, checking her surroundings as she walked.

name: Iori
message: 「Nice one. Alright, then I'll go call out to her...」

name: Asahi
message: 「What are you saying? Stay hidden!」
Asahi grabbed my sleeve and yanked me into the bushes.

name: Asahi
message: 「Phew, she didn't notice us. That was a close call.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Why are we hiding？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Let me ask you instead: what were you planning to do if you called out to her？」

name: Iori
message: 「I was going to scold her for skipping and convince her to attend class, though.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hah... Iori-sensei, I told you earlier, didn't I?」

name: Asahi
message: 「She's not the kind of person a sound argument works on. If straightforward persuasion were enough to make her comply, we wouldn't be going through all this trouble in the first place.」

name: Iori
message: 「That may be true, but then what are we supposed to do？」

name: Asahi
message: 「We tail her, look for weaknesses, and if we find anything, we record it as blackmail material.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If we stumble upon a decisive moment, we'll be in luck!」
W-What a terrifying thing to...

name: Iori
message: 「Haaah... The sweet, obedient Asahi-chan I used to know is no longer in this world...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, everyone grows up whether they like it or not.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san is on the move. Come on, let's go.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ugh, please don't let us get caught...！」
Offering a prayer to God, I followed Asahi and began tailing Setsugekka.
